decisions.reason: The new campaign-provisioning procedure still uses a Zap and does not change the existing requirement to synchronize HubSpot lists into MeetAlfred.
The source describes provisioning a new campaign and does not change the deferred workflow for moving silent leads into follow-up campaigns.
Setting up a campaign in MeetAlfred does not change the platform configuration requirement or its Pro subscription plan.
The source does not identify the new campaign as an email campaign or alter the deferred automated-email-campaign requirement.
The source does not identify the new campaign as a LinkedIn campaign or change the existing LinkedIn campaign behavior.
Duplicating and publishing a Zap does not change the Zapier platform configuration, subscription plan, or add-on requirement.
Creating a new campaign and duplicating a Zap does not revoke or modify the requirement to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
The source does not authorize use of production leads or change any test-identity or lead-isolation constraint.
The campaign-provisioning procedure does not change HubSpot lead-management properties, stages, lists, notes, or task assignment.
The source does not change the requirement to connect the campaign email system with MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
Provisioning a new campaign does not change how MeetAlfred replies update engagement status in HubSpot.
The source does not change visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
